summary: Mid-size ecommerce platform for outdoor gear and apparel. Replatforming search to semantic + rerank to reduce irrelevant clicks and increase conversion. Heavy seasonal variability (6-8x on Black Friday/Cyber Week). Evaluating Redwood for predictable cost/latency at scale.
notes:
Context: Built on microservices with legacy keyword search (Elastic) + feature store. Current pain: poor long-tail relevance, high ops overhead at sale peaks, and rising cost for managed vector store. Northshore is targeting a single inference stack to replace hybrid setup.

Key technical constraints:
- Catalog size: ~120M SKUs (including variants & region catalogs). Expect growth ~15%/yr.
- Query mix: 60% short navigation queries, 30% descriptive / long-tail, 10% embeddings-based similarity (recommendations).
- Latency SLOs: p50 60ms, p95 140ms, p99 <= 200ms for end-to-end search+rerank.
- Cost target: total cost-per-query (embeddings + rerank + ANN lookup) <= $0.015 (1.5 cents) avg across traffic profile.
- Seasonal: need autoscale up to 8x baseline throughput with predictable unit economics.

Architecture preferences discussed on call:
- Hybrid indexing: coarse ANN (quantized vectors) for 120M scale + dense cross-encoder reranker for top-K (K=30) to optimize precision/latency tradeoff.
- Embedding model: evaluating open-source 768-d models vs Redwood-hosted optimized encoders. Want quantized embedding store to reduce memory footprint.
- KV/prefix caching: required for repeat queries (category browse) to shave p95 latency during peaks.
- Fallbacks: cheaper model variants for non-conversion queries; routing by cost/latency thresholds.

Security & compliance:
- Must use customer KMS for key material (HSM future). Audit logs and retention policies required (1 year activity, 7 year data retention for invoices).
- SSO via SAML across internal tooling. Data residency requirement for EU catalogs.

Business/metrics they care about:
- Increase relevancy CTR on long-tail queries by 25%.
- Reduce cart abandonment attributed to search by 15% during promos.
- Keep unit cost steady during 6-8x spikes; target blended eCPM improvement vs current baseline.

Quotes from stakeholders:
- "We need deterministic billing at scale — last Black Friday our vector costs doubled unexpectedly." — Head of Platform
- "If rerank p99 jumps above 250ms, PMs will rollback the change." — Lead Product Manager

POC ask:
- Proof of concept to run against a 10% sampled catalog (~12M vectors) + synthetic spike test (x8 traffic) to validate latency and cost per query.
- Provide recommended batching/quantization config and expected per-query cost under baseline and peak.
- Security review and SOC2 attestation stub; answer KMS integration flow.

Stubs/links referenced in call: security FAQ (drive link), pricing deck (drive), synthetic spike plan (Jira RN-4532).
